European roulette rules & payouts

European roulette uses a wheel with 37 pockets: numbers 1–36 (alternating red/black) and a single 0 (green). A ball is spun and settles in one pocket; winning bets are those that cover the result.

Bet typeCoversPayout
Straight-up / 直注Single number (0–36)35 : 1
Red / Black18 numbers by color1 : 1
Odd / Even18 odd or even numbers (0 is neither)1 : 1
Low / High1–18 or 19–361 : 1
Dozen / 打1–12, 13–24, or 25–362 : 1
Column / 列12 numbers in a column2 : 1

Why single zero?

European (single-zero) roulette has a theoretical house edge of about 2.70% on standard bets, lower than American double-zero roulette (~5.26%). This demo uses the European wheel.

Not included in this demo

Split, street, corner, line and other combination/inside bets are common on full tables but omitted here to keep the layout lightweight and touch-friendly. Rules and odds shown match standard European roulette for the supported bets.

Frequently asked questions

Is this real-money gambling?
No. Neon Ace Roulette is a free entertainment demo with virtual chips only — no deposits, withdrawals, prizes or real-money wagering.
What is the difference from American roulette?
This is European roulette with a single 0 pocket (37 total). American roulette adds 00, increasing the house edge.
How is the result determined?
For this static demo, the winning number is generated locally with the Web Crypto API and the wheel animates to that result. It is not regulated or audited. Real-money products must use server-authoritative RNG and signed settlement.
Can I place multiple bets?
Yes. You can place chips on multiple numbers and/or outside bets in the same spin, as long as the total does not exceed your virtual bankroll.
Is it mobile-friendly and accessible?
Yes. Responsive layout, touch-sized bet cells, `aria-live` status, visible focus, and `prefers-reduced-motion` support. The full rules and payouts are indexable HTML.
